senses.gloss: (√גב, v. גבב) to collect a bill, taxes &c.; to make one’s self paid, to seize.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 90a:15">Keth. 90ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. if a later creditor (second mortgagee) <he>שקדם וג׳ מה שג׳ ג׳</he> collected first, what he has collected is his own.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 13b:6">B. Mets. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>גּוֹבֶה מנכסים ב״ח</he> he may make himself paid of unmortgaged property.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:1">Keth. V, 1</cite> <he>גּוֹבָה את הכל</he> she is entitled to the whole amount; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11">Lev. R. s. 11</cite> the king sent a treasury officer <he>לִגְבוֹת</he> to collect (the delinquent taxes); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42:3">Gen. R. s. 42</cite> <he>לִגְבוֹתָהּ</he>; Tanḥ. Sh’mini 9. [Lev. R. l. c. <he>וגבו אותו</he>, read <he>והכו</he>, cmp. Gen. R. l. c.] <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30:16">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> <he>מי ג׳ הימנו הדם וכ׳</he> who collected from him (punished him for) the blood on his hand? <he>לא ישראל גָּבוּ אותו וכ׳</he> not the Israelites collected it, but the Gibeonites did.—
Gen. R. s. 85; s. 92 end מצא ב״ח מקום לגבות וכ׳ the creditor met with a chance to collect his bill, i.e. the Lord takes this occasion to visit our sins; a. fr.—Part. pass. גָּבוּי collected, seized.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 58a">B. Mets. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>על הַגָּ׳</he> counting on the Shekel contributions collected (though not yet delivered in the Temple treasury); <cite ref="Ketubot 108a">Keth. 108ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 2:1:3">Y. Shek. II, beg. 46ᶜ</cite>.
<cite ref="Shevuot 48b">Shebu. 48ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כג׳ דמי</he> is considered as if collected (in the possession of the creditor); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be collected, to be collectible. B. Mets. l. c. על העתיד לִגָּבוֹת; Y. Shek. l. c. להִיגָּבוֹת on what is yet to be collected.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 8:7">Peah VIII, 7</cite> <he>הקופה נִגְבֵּית בשנים</he> the charity fund must be collected by two persons; <cite ref="Bava Batra 8b">B. Bath. 8ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 17b">Snh. 17ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> <he>לא היו נִיגְּבִים וכ׳</he> they were not highly taxed; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Challah 3:1">Ḥall. III, 1</cite> <he>מַגְבַּהַת חלתה</he> she orders the priest’s gift to be collected; v., however, <cite ref="C00049"><he>גָּבַהּ</he></cite>.
Gitt. 35ᵇ הַגְבּוּהָ את השאר help her to collect the balance. [Tosef. Sabb. VI (VII), 1 מגבה, v. גָּבַח.]—Part. pass. fem. מוּגְבָּה collected fund. Tanḥ. Emor 18.
